_read_first: STRUCTURE is reused on every site (TFTL does this across 96 projects). VALUES come from the picked idea every time: never copy ERA's, Monolog's or a past client's. Rules of thumb that held on the benchmarks, break them only for a reason the idea gives: tracking tightens and leading closes as size grows (display about 0.85-1.0 leading, -0.02 to -0.03em), labels go positive; greys are the ink at a lower alpha, not new colours; one radius family; few sizes (about 10-12 roles).
name: A

palette._how: Name each colour after something in the client's world (ERA: paper, ink, plum, sky, blush). Each gets alpha steps: --c-<name>-60 for secondary text, -30 disabled, -10 lines, -5 tinted grounds.

colors._how: Roles the starter uses, pointing at palette names. Hex values here are only a fallback.

accent.job: SET FROM THE IDEA: often the subject carries the colour and this is used almost nowhere

radius: sharp, soft, round or pill: pick one from the idea

owned_pages._how: Designed in the client's world, never left as defaults (every TFTL site does this).
